requirements.claim: Four departments for spend purposes: Engineering, Sales, Marketing, G&A
requirements.source_quote: Four departments for spend purposes.

requirements.claim: Exec team sits inside G&A rather than as a separate department
requirements.source_quote: Inside G&A is fine.

requirements.claim: CEO Marcus Webb's card should effectively have no limit
requirements.source_quote: I never want to see a decline.

requirements.claim: Diane offers $50k/month as the practical equivalent of no limit
requirements.source_quote: Fifty grand a month?

requirements.claim: Priya wants a very-high ceiling rather than none, for auditors
requirements.source_quote: Can we do very-high instead of none?

requirements.claim: Roster carries per-person target monthly limits and is authoritative for them
requirements.source_quote: On the roster I marked target monthly limits per person.

requirements.claim: Stated precedence: the roster wins over anything said on the call
requirements.source_quote: Where the roster and anything I say today disagree, the roster wins

requirements.claim: Tier 1: under $500 auto-approves with no friction
requirements.source_quote: Anything under five hundred dollars, people should just be able to spend.

requirements.claim: Tier 2 manager approval $500-$5,000; Tier 3 over $5,000 to Diane
requirements.source_quote: Then five hundred to five thousand, your manager should sign off. And anything over five thousand comes to me.

requirements.claim: Top tier routes to Diane personally, not to the VP Finance role; no delegation
requirements.source_quote: Me specifically for now. If I'm out, it waits.

requirements.claim: Dedicated virtual software card held by IT
requirements.source_quote: We want a dedicated software card — virtual — that lives with IT.

requirements.claim: Any new software vendor needs Diane's approval regardless of amount
requirements.source_quote: software vendor needs my approval regardless of amount

requirements.claim: Software program monthly cap of $10,000
requirements.source_quote: Call it eight thousand a month, cap it at ten to be safe.

requirements.claim: Software card must decline non-software purchases
requirements.source_quote: And it should decline anything that isn't software-ish.

requirements.claim: Travel program restricted to travel categories
requirements.source_quote: restricted to actual travel categories — airlines, hotels, rideshare, restaurants while traveling

requirements.claim: Travel limit of $2,000 per month per traveling rep
requirements.source_quote: We budgeted two thousand a month per traveling rep.

requirements.claim: Travelers are all of Sales plus Marcus, Diane, and Tom Reyes
requirements.source_quote: Everyone in Sales, plus Marcus, plus me, plus Tom Reyes in Marketing

requirements.claim: Engineering gets travel access on request rather than by default
requirements.source_quote: Nobody in Engineering by default; they can request.

requirements.claim: Physical cards for all of Sales; virtual for everyone else
requirements.source_quote: physical for everyone in Sales anyway, they're client-facing, they expense dinners

requirements.claim: Kevin O'Rourke is a contractor needing maximum lockdown and no visibility into others' spend
requirements.source_quote: he should absolutely not see anything about anyone else's spend

requirements.claim: Office manager Renata needs her own card with a decent limit
requirements.source_quote: She should have her own card with a decent limit

requirements.claim: Priya runs the books and needs to see everything and close the month
requirements.source_quote: She needs to see everything, close the month, all of it.

requirements.claim: Diane and Priya administer the instance
requirements.source_quote: Priya and me.

requirements.claim: Sana in IT handles the user-management side because she runs identity
requirements.source_quote: And probably Sana in IT for the user-management side, since she runs our identity stuff

requirements.claim: Sana must not be able to change spend limits — people administration only
requirements.source_quote: Sana should not be able to change spend limits though. Just people stuff.

requirements.claim: Marketing was reorged; the two newest Marketing hires' managers are unconfirmed
requirements.source_quote: The roster's manager column is right for everyone except possibly the two newest Marketing hires

requirements.claim: Do not guess the Marketing reorg answer, and do not block on it
requirements.source_quote: Don't block on it, but don't invent an answer either.

requirements.claim: Reimbursements stay enabled for edge cases despite a card-first goal
requirements.source_quote: Keep reimbursements on for edge cases

requirements.claim: Receipts required over $75
requirements.source_quote: Required over seventy-five dollars.

requirements.claim: Memo required for anything over $500
requirements.source_quote: And memo required for anything over five hundred.
